Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Under the Hawthorn Tree" came out earlier by comparing only the month and day of the release dates (11-26 vs 09-15) without considering the year. This oversight led to the erroneous conclusion that a film released in 2010 was earlier than one released in 1965. The Planner failed to correctly account for the full chronological context of the release years, which is a critical error in determining which film came out earlier.
